posttrainbench.description: A CLI agent post-trains a supplied base model for a target benchmark within a fixed compute budget.
posttrainbench.input: Small base model, target task and fixed compute
posttrainbench.assessment: Held-out target performance aggregated across model–task pairs
posttrainbench.first_author_affil: ELLIS Institute Tübingen; Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems; Tübingen AI Center

frontier-rsi.description: Improve a model or its training and inference pipeline against a held-out objective under a fixed budget.
frontier-rsi.input: Open-ended AI engineering objective and fixed compute budget
frontier-rsi.assessment: Task metric normalized to best valid trial; two-trial average
frontier-rsi.date_note: Public project announcement. This suite tests prerequisites for AI improvement, not confirmed recursive gains.

posttrainbench-1-1.description: Post-train a supplied model under a fixed compute budget with explicit contamination, API-use and model-identity checks.
posttrainbench-1-1.input: A base model, target task and fixed compute budget
posttrainbench-1-1.assessment: Held-out target scores under v1.1 integrity checks.

posttrainbench-1-2.description: Post-train small base models on six reweighted benchmark targets with revised HumanEval scoring.
posttrainbench-1-2.input: A base model, target task and fixed compute budget
posttrainbench-1-2.assessment: Held-out performance averaged over up to five final-evaluation seeds with revised contamination adjudication.

posttrain-arena.description: Assess the training benefit of an environment collection under a fixed recipe.
posttrain-arena.input: A fixed base model and submitted training environments.
posttrain-arena.output: Post-training performance on an independent held-out suite.
posttrain-arena.assessment: Held-out pass rate after training minus the corresponding rate before training, in percentage points.
